description:
External works: Demolition of the non-original rear outrigger and replacement with a full width rear extension at lower ground floor level. Rear garden excavation to form an enlarged patio area at lower ground floor and rebuilding of non-original brick garden walls where failing. Replacement of single glazed window with double glazed timber windows. ASHP (an air source heat pump) unit and solar panels at roof level. Removal of non-original, non-breathable paint on the rear facade and reinstatement of the brick with new lime mortar. Replacement of the soil pipe and rainwater down pipe on the rear facade

Internal works: Internal remodelling at lower ground floor to create a new stair, kitchen/dining, snug and shower room. Placement of a bathroom on the first floor in the rear room. Placement of breathable wood fibre insulation and lime plaster to external walls; removal of all non-original plasterboard and hardboard ceilings, filling with thermal and acoustic insulation and new plasterboard placed back; rewiring/new plumbing and heating works throughout; reinstatement of four historically appropriate fireplaces into bricked up chimney breasts

 [Listed Building Consent P2026/2458/LBC also submitted].
